map.毛利率计算器，输入营收与营业成本，按毛利率=(营收−成本)/营收求毛利水平，辅助: Gross margin calculator: enter revenue and operating cost and compute the gross margin as (revenue - cost) / revenue, to support pricing strategy and profit structure analysis.
map.衡量产品直接盈利能力，对比不同产品线或渠道的毛利水平。: Measure the direct profitability of a product and compare gross margin levels across product lines or channels.
map.定价策略制定时，确保毛利率覆盖运营与税费后仍有净利。: When setting pricing strategy, make sure the gross margin still leaves net profit after covering operations and taxes.
map.监控毛利率趋势，预警原材料涨价或价格战侵蚀利润。: Monitor the gross margin trend and warn of raw material price rises or price wars eroding profit.
map.：某公司收入 1000 万元、营业成本 700 万元，毛利=1000−700=3: : A company with revenue of 10,000,000 CNY and operating cost of 7,000,000 CNY has gross profit = 10,000,000 - 7,000,000 = 3,000,000 CNY and a gross margin of 3,000,000/10,000,000 = 30%, meaning 0.3 CNY of every 1 CNY of revenue becomes profit after covering expenses.
map.由营收与营业成本求毛利: Gross profit from revenue and operating cost
map.由 EBIT 与利息费用求保障倍数: Interest coverage ratio from EBIT and interest expense
map.由存货与营业成本求存货天数: Inventory days from inventory and operating cost
map.毛利率和净利率有什么区别？: What is the difference between gross margin and net margin?
map.毛利率只扣直接营业成本，反映产品本身的盈利空间；净利率再扣除费用、利息、税后得到: Gross margin deducts only direct operating cost and reflects the profit space of the product itself; net margin further deducts expenses, interest and tax to give final profit, a fuller measure.
map.毛利率下降一定不好吗？: Is a falling gross margin always bad?
map.不一定。为抢占市场主动降价会降毛利率，但若带来销量与规模效应提升，长期净利可能反: Not necessarily. Cutting prices to seize market share lowers the gross margin, but if it raises volume and brings scale effects, long-term net profit may actually improve; it must be read together with the volume-price strategy.
